description: This file implements a class and functions for traversing and transforming abstract syntax trees (ASTs) related to loop conditions in shader code, specifically simplifying loop conditions by hoisting or restructuring them for further processing.

classes.name: SimplifyLoopConditionsTraverser
classes.description: An AST traverser class that simplifies loop conditions by hoisting or restructuring them within loop constructs.

methods.name: SimplifyLoopConditionsTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a mask for conditions to simplify and a symbol table.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Visits unary AST nodes to identify conditions to simplify.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Visits binary AST nodes to identify conditions to simplify.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate AST nodes to identify conditions to simplify.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Visits ternary AST nodes to identify conditions to simplify.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Visits declaration AST nodes to identify conditions to simplify.

methods.name: traverseLoop
methods.description: Traverses and potentially transforms loop nodes to hoist or restructure loop conditions.
